assets.name: crowd-far-v2
assets.prompt: Create a very distant crowd layer for this warm violet and golden illustrated plaza concert. Wide 3:1 canvas. At the bottom 25% only: a dense low band of approximately 100 tiny audience silhouettes, backs toward the camera, simple heads/shoulders/raised arms and small golden or pink glow sticks. People are small, atmospheric muted violet shapes with amber rimlight, enough soft painted detail to match the reference. DISTINCT composition: no child riding shoulders, no large backpacks, no large foreground heads, no recognizable repeated figures. Upper 70% canvas completely TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA. No buildings, no floor, no stage, no backdrop. All audience feet cropped by bottom canvas, as a low distant audience layer.
